The company also reported that search referral traffic was 'meaningfully down,' which is concerning given the street believes Reddit's valuation is contingent on search visibility. DAU growth has stalled for the second or fourth consecutive quarter depending on the metric. The stock fell 10-18% after hours despite beating on revenue (up 53% year-over-year) and EPS (up 75% year-over-year). While cash flow and ARPU metrics are strong, the core issue is user acquisition stagnation, which threatens long-term growth despite impressive near-term monetization.
